verses.text: ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés icha tik: --Ixik, b'at il winh rey chi', tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manh ol aktejel in chonhab' tik, ol wak'och yaelal t'a ib'anh, ol wak' pitzwokk'e nok' pajtza' t'a masanil a makb'en tik.

Ol wak' pitzwok nok' t'a yol ha ha' smasanil, ol laj och nok' t'a yol a despacho yet' b'aj tzach wayi. Ol laj k'e nok' t'a sat a ch'at. Ol laj och nok' t'a yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio het'ok, t'a yoltak spat masanil anima, t'a yoltak horno b'aj sb'o ixim pan tza wa''a yet' t'a sattak ak'ante' b'aj syotz'chaj ixim pan chi'.
Ol laj k'e nok' t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a winhaj Aarón to syak'b'at te' sk'okoch winh t'a yib'anh smasanil ha ha': Ha kotak ha' yet' a niwak nhajab', yik sk'eta b'ulnaj nok' pajtza'. Ol majel yol yik Egipto tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at te' sk'okoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yib'anh ha ha' chi'. Ix k'eul b'ulnaj nok' pajtza' chi', ix majel masanil yoltak chonhab' chi' yuj nok'.
Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutejpax heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yet' tas k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb', ix japax nok' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yuj heb'.

Ix laj te pukax nok', yuj chi' ix awtaj heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --k'anek t'a Jehová, yik ol yik'el nok' pajtza' tik t'a ko kal, ol waktanel he chonhab' tik, yik sb'at heb' yak' silab' t'ay, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés t'a winh: --Ha ach ol ala' b'ak'inh tzin lesalwi t'a Jehová yik syik'anel nok' pajtza' tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a skal masanil anima yet' t'a yoltak he pat. Haxonhej t'a yol ha' Nilo ol kan nok', xchi winh.
--K'ik'an, xchi winh rey chi'. Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi': --Icha chi' ol ajok, yik ol ojtakejeli to malaj junokxo lajan spoder icha Jehová ko Diosal a onh tik.
Icha chi' ol aj yel nok' t'a a despacho yet' t'a yol spat heb' ayoch yajalil het'ok yet' t'a skal masanil anima. Ol kannhej nok' t'a yol ha' Nilo, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi, ix elta heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix sk'anan winhaj Moisés t'a Jehová to tz'el nok' pajtza' chi'.
Ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi'. Ichato chi' ix laj och ijan scham masanil nok' pajtza' t'a yoltak pat, t'a amak' yet' t'a kaltak te'.
Haxo heb' anima ix laj molb'an nok' chamnak pajtza' chi' t'a junjun b'ulanh, chuklaj ix aj sjab' yuj nok'.
Ayik ix yilan winh rey to manhxalaj yaelal ayoch t'a yib'anh winh, ix yak'anxi pitb'okel spensar winh, icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalani, maj sk'anab'ajejlaj winh tas ix yal t'a heb' winh chawanh chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Al t'a winhaj Aarón to syik'chaanh te' sk'okoch winh, smak'an spokokal lum lum winh yet' te' yik smeltzajoch lum pokok chi' kotak usal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik, xchi.

Ichaton chi' ix yutej winhaj Aarón chi'. Ix smak'k'e waan lum pokok chi' winh yet' te' sk'okoch, yuj chi' masanil lum pokok ay t'a yol yik Egipto chi', ix laj och lum kotak usal, ix och nok' t'a anima yet' t'a nok' nok'.

Hanheja' heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yalani, icha ix yutej winhaj Aarón chi' icha chi' ix yutejpax heb' winh snaani. Ix snib'ej heb' winh ix och lum pokok chi' kotak usal, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh. Ix chiji heb' anima yet' nok' nok' yuj nok' us chi'.

Yuj chi', ix yal heb' winh ay tas tzuji yuj yalani t'a winh rey chi': --Ha jun tik, ha Dios tz'utani, xchi heb' winh. Palta ix pitb'iel spensar winh rey chi', icha wal ix yutej Jehová yalani. Maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ha k'ik'an t'a sakb'inaji, sb'at winh rey chi' t'a sti' ha ha', yuj chi' pet ex k'e waan, b'at eyalan t'a winh: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Aktejel heb' in chonhab' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.

Palta tato manh ol aktejel heb', ol wak'kot junok umanh nok' kach icha tab' t'a ib'anh, t'a yib'anh masanil heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' pax t'a yib'anh masanil a chonhab'. Ol b'ut'jokel masanil yol he pat yet' masanil sat lu'um yuj nok'.

Ayik ol ujok juntzanh chi', manhxalaj junok nok' kach chi' ol ek' t'a yol yik Gosén b'aj ayek' heb' in chonhab'. Icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to a in Jehová in, Dios in t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hata' ol ojtakejeli to ch'ok yel in chonhab' tik t'a yichanh a chonhab' chi' t'a yol in sat. Ha k'ik'an, max ek'b'atlaj saklemb'at nok' kach, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová. Ichaxo wal tab' yek' nok' kach chi', ix ochk'och nok' t'a yol sdespacho winh rey yet' t'a yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' masanil t'a yol smakb'en Egipto. Junelnhej ix yixtejb'at yol chonhab' chi' nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ixikek, ix ak'ek he silab' t'a he Diosal chi', palta manh ex el t'a yol yik Egipto tik, xchi winh.

Haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Max yal-laj icha chi', yujto a nok' nok' skak' t'a silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal chi', niwan yelk'och nok' t'a yol sat heb' etchonhab' tik. Yuj chi, tato syil heb' anima chi' ko milancham nok' a onh tik, wal yel tzam onh sjulk'enej heb'.
Yuj chi', yowalil tzonh b'at t'a tzinan lu'um, oxe' k'ual stek'nab'il b'aj tzonh b'at chi'. Hato ta' b'at kak' ko silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, icha ix yutej yalani, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi': --Syal he b'at t'a tzinan lum chi', yik b'at eyak' he silab' t'a Jehová he Diosal chi', anhej tato yel manh najatok tzex b'ati, tze k'anan t'a he Diosal chi' wuj a in tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh: --Anhej wal tzin el t'a tik, tzin k'anan t'a Jehová to a k'ik'an tz'el nok' kach tik t'ayach, t'a heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' t'a masanil a makb'en tik. Palta manhxookab' onh ixtej, manhxaokab'pax tas ol al t'ayonh ayik ol b'at kak'an ko silab' t'a Jehová chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixnhej wal elta winhaj Moisés t'a yol sdespacho winh rey chi', ix sk'anan winh t'a Jehová.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi', ix yik'anel nok' kach t'a winh rey chi' yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' t'a masanil heb' anima. Manhxa junok nok' ix kani.
Palta hanheja' ix spitejxi sb'a winh rey chi', maj chajiel-laj heb' israel chi' yuj winh.
